$comment: Declared versions NOT published from this repository, each with the reason.
State is computed from this repository's git tags. a1 and a2 were published
from dotmac_starter_mt and their tags stay there permanently.
The 0.1.0a12 row that sat here between the declaration and the publication
was removed by the RECORDER, as a8 through a11 were — the gesture a human
forgot twice (a4 by six silent hours, a7 loudly at every open pull request)
is now the verify run's own last act.
0.1.0a3 is published and permanently unpinnable; 0.1.0a4 and 0.1.0a5 are
published, verified, and refused for adoption; 0.1.0a6 through 0.1.0a10
remain published and verified; 0.1.0a11 is published and verified; 0.1.0a12
is published, verified, carries the separately-signed recovery grant and the
owner-computed fleet reads, and is the version to pin. All of them live in
docs/published-versions.json,
each superseding disposition APPENDED to its original record rather than
replacing it.
A row here and a row in docs/published-versions.json are never both true
about one version at once, and
test_the_ledger_and_the_published_record_never_claim_the_same_version states
that over the two FILES so it holds even in a tagless checkout.
NOT EMPTY: `0.1.0a12+dev` is the tree's current declaration, and it names a
PEP 440 local segment rather than a new alpha. main diverged from the a12
bytes the moment the attestation trust registry migration
(dc_0011_attestation_registry) and the read-only trust-root binding facade
(attestation_binding.py, merged 540c17fa) landed after a12 was tagged, so a
bare `0.1.0a12` would name bytes the tree no longer has. The marker
allocates nothing and cannot be published — the next number this repository
may allocate is derived, at allocation time, as the successor of the
highest version in docs/published-versions.json (today 0.1.0a12, so a13).

0.1.0a12+dev.reason: Post-a12 development marker, not a new alpha awaiting release. 0.1.0a12 itself is published and verified (tag_object 2df5b0b8d18a61dd0802b11c3502d01d44222a66, peeled_commit 8e8342bcbefc7d25f2877c440552a276c1226ba4, release_run 33854964978, verify_run 33855190724 — see docs/published-versions.json). main has since diverged from those bytes: the attestation trust registry migration (dc_0011_attestation_registry) and the read-only trust-root binding facade (attestation_binding.py, merged 540c17fa) both landed after a12 published, so a bare 0.1.0a12 declaration would misname the tree's current bytes as a12's own. This row exists only so the declared-publication gate can account for the marker; it is removed, without ever having named a real release, the moment the tree bumps to the next allocated number.
